feature: Keyboard-Driven Photo Selection with Export Destination Prompt
workflow_rationale: This task adds new functionality (keyboard navigation and early export destination selection) to an existing screen without changing the underlying architecture. Single-service Flutter app with 4 files to modify.

phases.name: Provider Extensions
phases.description: Add necessary state and methods to providers: export directory state, undo group functionality, and selection helper methods

subtasks.description: Add exportDirectoryProvider StateProvider to export_provider.dart to store selected export directory path
subtasks.implementation_notes: Add: final exportDirectoryProvider = StateProvider<String?>((ref) => null); This simple StateProvider stores the selected directory path (null for web or if user cancels).

subtasks.description: Add undoLastGroup() method to GroupsNotifier with tracking of last created group
subtasks.implementation_notes: Add _lastCreatedGroupId field to track last group. In createGroupFromSelection(), store group.id before adding to state. Add undoLastGroup() method that: 1) finds group by _lastCreatedGroupId, 2) gets its imageIds, 3) calls markAsUngrouped on those IDs via _ref, 4) removes group from state, 5) clears _lastCreatedGroupId.

subtasks.description: Add selectImageAt(), deselectImageAt(), and markAsUngrouped() methods to ImportedImagesNotifier
subtasks.implementation_notes: Add three methods: 1) selectImageAt(int index, List<ImportedImage> ungrouped) - gets image at index from ungrouped list, sets isSelected=true using copyWith; 2) deselectImageAt(int index, List<ImportedImage> ungrouped) - same but isSelected=false; 3) markAsUngrouped(List<String> ids) - for each id, set isGrouped=false. All use immutable state updates with map().

phases.name: UI Implementation
phases.description: Convert GroupingScreen to ConsumerStatefulWidget, add export destination dialog on entry, keyboard event handling, and visual cursor indicator

subtasks.description: Convert GroupingScreen from ConsumerWidget to ConsumerStatefulWidget with cursor position state
subtasks.implementation_notes: Change class declaration to: class GroupingScreen extends ConsumerStatefulWidget. Create _GroupingScreenState extends ConsumerState<GroupingScreen>. Add int _cursorIndex = 0 as local state. Move build() logic to state class. Add _hasPromptedForDirectory bool to track if dialog shown.

subtasks.description: Add export destination dialog that shows when entering GroupingScreen (desktop/mobile only)
subtasks.implementation_notes: In initState(), add WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback() to show dialog after build. Check if kIsWeb - skip on web. Call ExportService.getExportDirectory() and store result in exportDirectoryProvider. Handle null result (user cancelled) gracefully - allow continuing without directory.

subtasks.description: Add Focus widget with keyboard event handler for Space, Shift+Space, Enter, Shift+Enter shortcuts
subtasks.implementation_notes: Wrap Scaffold body with Focus(autofocus: true, onKeyEvent: _handleKeyEvent, child: ...). In _handleKeyEvent: check event is KeyDownEvent, check HardwareKeyboard.instance.isShiftPressed. Handle 4 cases: Space (select + advance), Shift+Space (deselect + go back), Enter (create group), Shift+Enter (undo group). Clamp _cursorIndex after each operation. Return KeyEventResult.handled or .ignored.

subtasks.description: Add visual cursor indicator (highlight border) to currently focused photo in grid
subtasks.implementation_notes: Pass _cursorIndex to _SelectableThumbnail or create wrapper. Add isCursor bool parameter. When isCursor is true, add a distinct colored border (e.g., Colors.orange or Theme.of(context).colorScheme.tertiary) to distinguish from selected state (which uses primary color). Consider adding subtle animation or glow effect.

phases.name: Integration and Edge Cases
phases.description: Wire all components together, handle edge cases, and verify end-to-end functionality

subtasks.description: Implement auto-navigation logic: advance cursor after select (Space), go back after deselect (Shift+Space)
subtasks.implementation_notes: After Space: _cursorIndex = (_cursorIndex + 1).clamp(0, ungroupedImages.length - 1). After Shift+Space: _cursorIndex = (_cursorIndex - 1).clamp(0, ungroupedImages.length - 1). Call setState() to rebuild. Handle edge case where list becomes empty after grouping - reset cursor to 0.

subtasks.description: Handle edge cases: empty list, cursor bounds, no groups to undo, text field focus
subtasks.implementation_notes: 1) If ungroupedImages.isEmpty, show completion message and disable keyboard nav. 2) Clamp cursor to valid range whenever list changes. 3) In undoLastGroup, check if _lastCreatedGroupId exists. 4) CRITICAL: Check FocusScope.of(context).hasPrimaryFocus or detect if TextField has focus - don't handle keyboard events when user is typing in group name/SKU fields.

subtasks.description: End-to-end verification: test complete keyboard workflow with export directory integration

verification.instructions: 1) Run flutter run -d macos (or windows). 2) Import some images from ImportScreen. 3) Navigate to GroupingScreen - verify export directory dialog appears. 4) Select a directory. 5) Press Space multiple times - verify photos select and cursor advances. 6) Press Shift+Space - verify photo deselects and cursor goes back. 7) Press Enter - verify group is created. 8) Press Shift+Enter - verify group is undone. 9) Verify cursor indicator is visible. 10) Try typing in group name field - verify Space/Enter don't trigger shortcuts while typing.

parallelism.speedup_estimate: N/A - sequential workflow (UI changes depend on provider changes)

acceptance_criteria: Export destination dialog appears on GroupingScreen entry (desktop/mobile)
Space key selects current photo and advances cursor
Shift+Space deselects current photo and moves cursor backward
Enter key creates group from selected photos
Shift+Enter undoes the last created group
Visual cursor indicator visible on focused photo
Keyboard shortcuts don't interfere with text input fields
Edge cases handled gracefully (empty list, bounds, no undo available)
verification_strategy.reasoning: Low risk UI feature with changes isolated to grouping screen and state providers. Static analysis ensures code quality. Unit tests for state logic are sufficient.

checks: No export directory dialog (skipped on web)
